column7: a PARTIAL key-material set -- some required key files present, some missing -- refuses to start. Deliberately scoped to presence/absence only: that is decidable from os.Stat alone and cannot be fooled by how the files were copied in. The mtime-gap check in internal/keyfiles/consistency.go is a documented BEST-EFFORT heuristic and is NOT claimed here, because plain cp / install / docker cp / kubectl cp all stamp the destination mtime with the current time, so a set assembled from two different backups by the most common means shows no gap at all. A real mixed-generation guarantee needs an atomically written key-set manifest (generation id plus per-file hash) verified at boot -- see #2896
